_comment: De-circularized grid. payload_set='heldout' runs the independently-authored payloads (fixtures.HELDOUT_PAYLOADS) that contain NONE of the defense's trigger strings, so a defended ASR drop here cannot be the filter recognizing its own vocabulary. Each class runs on the task(s) that give it a structural opening (class_tasks). n per (model,class) cell = (#tasks x 5 payloads x #seeds); with 4 seeds that is >=20 on every cell, and 40 on the two metadata classes that run on two tasks.
